assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide website hero BACKGROUND for L&K Group, a Sydney local company offering residential painting, existing cabinet painting, handyman care, paint touch-up kits and kimchi. Primary request: a tasteful realistic editorial scene suggesting a well-cared-for home and everyday life, not a collage. Scene: airy Australian suburban home in warm afternoon natural light, living area opens into a neat kitchen with muted sage painted existing cabinets, warm oak accents, linen furnishings. On a modest kitchen table at the RIGHT side are a discreet plain paint sample/touch-up pot and small brush next to a closed tidy maintenance toolbox; a simple small bowl of red cabbage kimchi on a separate dining place setting suggests everyday food, with believable separation from maintenance supplies. Left HALF is uncluttered quiet neutral wall and soft shadow space suitable for readable overlaid website heading. No people, no text, no labels, no brand logos, no watermark, no renovation before/after, no luxurious mansion, no Sydney landmarks. Cohesive ivory, warm timber, slate and sage tones. Photorealistic architectural/lifestyle photography, restrained and trustworthy, rich real materials. Landscape 16:9 or wider composition, room details and table grouped to the right so they survive a mobile crop.
